demo.disclosure: Demo · Sample data. Actions only change state in this browser and reset when you switch scenarios.

PENDING_EXPERT_RESPONSE.title: Waiting for {{name}} to accept
PENDING_EXPERT_RESPONSE.body: The expert is reviewing the service scope, review package and timeline. You don't pay anything yet. Once the expert accepts, you have 24 hours to pay and hold the slot.

DECLINED_BY_EXPERT.title: {{name}} declined the request
DECLINED_BY_EXPERT.body: You haven't paid, so you were not charged. You can send this file to another expert on the marketplace.

EXPERT_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT.title: {{name}} did not respond in time
EXPERT_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT.body: The request closed automatically and you were not charged. You can send this file to another expert on the marketplace.

WITHDRAWN.title: You withdrew the request
WITHDRAWN.body: The request closed before the expert accepted, so you were not charged.

AWAITING_PAYMENT.title: Pay to hold your review slot
AWAITING_PAYMENT.body: {{name}} accepted the case. The slot is locked for you; if you don't pay within 24 hours, the request is cancelled and the slot released.
AWAITING_PAYMENT.escrow: Shared Hub holds your payment until you accept the result.
AWAITING_PAYMENT.link: Each PayOS payment link is valid for 15 minutes. If a link expires, create a new one while the payment deadline is still open.

CANCELLED_UNPAID.title: Request cancelled: payment not received
CANCELLED_UNPAID.body: The 24-hour payment window ended. The expert's slot has been released and you were not charged.

PAYMENT_CONFIRMED.title: Payment held, waiting for the expert to start
PAYMENT_CONFIRMED.body: The expert must confirm the review start before the deadline. If they don't, the case is cancelled and you get a 100% refund.

UNPAID.title: You cancelled the request
UNPAID.body: You cancelled before paying, so you were not charged. The expert's slot has been released.

USER_CANCELLED_BEFORE_START.title: You cancelled before the expert started
USER_CANCELLED_BEFORE_START.body: Your payment is refunded in full.

EXPERT_START_TIMEOUT.title: Cancelled · expert did not start on time
EXPERT_START_TIMEOUT.body: Your payment is refunded in full under the refund policy.

IN_REVIEW.title: The expert is reviewing your file
IN_REVIEW.body: You'll be notified if the expert needs more information and when the result is delivered.
IN_REVIEW.overdue: The expert missed the delivery deadline. A result delivered within the grace period is still accepted and you get part of the fee back; if nothing is delivered by then, the case is terminated and the fee is split under the policy fixed at booking.
IN_REVIEW.lateTerms: If the expert delivers up to {{hours}} h late you get {{late}} back; if nothing is delivered after that you get {{none}} back.

AWAITING_USER_INFORMATION.title: The expert needs more information
AWAITING_USER_INFORMATION.warning: If you don't respond within 72 hours, the case is terminated and the expert still receives 60% of the fee. If you did respond on time, you then have 72 hours to challenge the decision.
AWAITING_USER_INFORMATION.responseHint: Answer each item the expert asked for. Up to 2,000 characters.
AWAITING_USER_INFORMATION.filesHint: PDF, Excel or images, up to 20 MB each.
AWAITING_USER_INFORMATION.required: Enter a response or attach at least one document.
AWAITING_USER_INFORMATION.warningNoRefund: If you do not answer in time the case ends and you get nothing back.
AWAITING_USER_INFORMATION.warningRefund: If you do not answer in time the case ends and you get only {{amount}} back.

AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE.title: Result delivered: please review and accept
AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE.body: Review the result below, then accept it or report an issue. If you take no action before the deadline, the case is confirmed automatically.
AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE.principle: You pay for the expert's review work; the fee does not depend on the file being VERIFIED.

COMPLETED.title: Case completed
COMPLETED.USER_ACCEPTED: You accepted the result. The payment has been settled.
COMPLETED.AUTO_CONFIRMED: The acceptance window ended, so the case was confirmed and settled automatically.

DISPUTED.title: Your complaint is under review
DISPUTED.body: The payment stays on hold and is not paid out to the expert until a decision is made.
DISPUTED.sla: A Dispute Admin responds within {{days}} working days.
DISPUTED.escalation: If the dispute needs professional judgment, it is escalated to an independent expert reviewer; admins do not replace the expert's professional conclusion.
DISPUTED.late: The decision is taking longer than expected; the fee stays safely on hold and you will be told as soon as it is decided.

TERMINATED.title: Case terminated
TERMINATED.USER_NON_RESPONSE: You did not respond to the information request within 72 hours.
TERMINATED.USER_CANCELLED: You cancelled after the expert started the review.
TERMINATED.EXPERT_ABANDON: The expert did not deliver within the service deadline.
TERMINATED.SYSTEM_ERROR: A system error prevented the case from continuing.
TERMINATED.challengeBody: If you responded on time or the information request was not valid, you can challenge this decision. The payment stays on hold until the challenge window ends or a decision is made.
TERMINATED.challengeOpen: Your challenge is under review. The case stays terminated; the payment stays on hold until a decision is made.

settlement.title: Settlement
settlement.once: Each case has exactly one final settlement for this payment.

rules.AUTO_CONFIRMED: Auto-confirmed when the acceptance window ended
rules.EXPERT_START_TIMEOUT: Expert did not start on time
rules.LATE_DELIVERY: The expert delivered late; you get the late refund fixed at booking

package.title: Review package
package.pending: The review package is locked when you send the request.
package.note: Versions you create after the lock do not replace the package the expert is reviewing.

events.responseTimeout: Expert did not respond in time
events.startTimeout: Expert did not start on time

accept.title: Accept the result?
accept.body: The case moves to Completed and the payment is settled at the split fixed at booking. After accepting, you can no longer report an issue.
accept.lateRefund: The expert delivered late, so {{amount}} comes back to you.

cancel.title: Cancel a case in review?
cancel.body: The expert has already started, so the case is settled under the cancellation policy:

PENDING_EXPERT_RESPONSE.title: Withdraw the review request?
PENDING_EXPERT_RESPONSE.body: The expert hasn't accepted yet, so you won't be charged. To get a review later, send a new request.

AWAITING_PAYMENT.title: Cancel the review request?
AWAITING_PAYMENT.body: You haven't paid, so you won't be charged. The expert's slot will be released.

PAYMENT_CONFIRMED.title: Cancel before the expert starts?
PAYMENT_CONFIRMED.body: The expert hasn't started, so you get a 100% refund of your payment.

report.title: Report an issue with the result
report.body: The payment stays on hold until a decision. If the administrator upholds the issue you get {{amount}} back; if it is rejected the case settles as if you had accepted.
report.descriptionHint: Describe what is wrong, where it appears in the result and the supporting evidence.
report.descriptionRequired: Write at least 20 characters so the Dispute Admin has enough to review.
report.bodyHold: The payment stays on hold until the dispute is decided.

challenge.title: Challenge the termination
challenge.body: Your challenge is handled as a separate dispute. The case stays terminated; the payment stays on hold until a decision is made.
challenge.descriptionHint: State when you responded or why the information request was not valid, with evidence if you have it.

toast.paid: Payment received. The funds are on hold.
toast.answered: Response sent. The case is back in review.
toast.disputed: Complaint submitted. The payment stays on hold.
toast.cancelled: Case cancelled and settled under the cancellation policy.
toast.withdrawn: Request withdrawn. You were not charged.
toast.challenged: Challenge sent. The payment stays on hold.
toast.expired: Payment deadline passed. The request was cancelled.
toast.disputeWithdrawn: Dispute withdrawn. The case is accepted and settled.
toast.extensionAccepted: Extension accepted. The delivery deadline moved.

notFound.title: Case not found
notFound.body: This case ID doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.

request.title: Send a review request
request.lead: Choose the AI file you want an expert to verify. You pay right after sending; the fee is held until you accept the result.
request.draftRequired: Choose a file to send for review.
request.noDrafts: You don't have an AI file ready for review yet.
request.scopeHint: Optional. Point out what you want the expert to focus on, up to 1,000 characters.
request.filesHint: Optional. PDF, Excel or images, up to 20 MB each.
request.consent: I understand: I pay when I send the request; the payment is held until I accept the result and fully refunded if the expert does not take the case; the fee pays for the review work and does not depend on a VERIFIED result.
request.consentRequired: Confirm the terms to send the request.
request.shortfall: Your wallet is {{amount}} short of the review fee.

steps.s1: You pay within 15 minutes; Shared Hub holds the fee.
steps.s2: The expert accepts or declines within 1 working day; if not, you get a 100% refund.
steps.s3: The expert delivers within 1 working day; you have 1 working day to accept.

request.serviceMissing: This service is no longer open for booking. Choose again on the expert's profile.

terms.title: What you get back in each case
terms.late: The expert delivers up to {{hours}} h late: you get {{amount}} back.
terms.noDelivery: The expert does not deliver: you get {{amount}} back.
terms.noResponseNoRefund: You do not answer a question within {{days}} working days: the case ends and nothing is refunded.
terms.noResponseRefund: You do not answer a question within {{days}} working days: the case ends and you get only {{amount}} back.
terms.dispute: The administrator upholds your dispute: you get {{amount}} back.

upload.title: Or upload a document you already have
upload.hint: PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP or Word (.docx), up to 50 MB. The uploaded file is chosen as the document to review.

request.workingDays: Working days leave out Saturdays, Sundays and solar-calendar public holidays. A deadline that falls on a day off moves to the next working day, same time.
request.noVersion: This document has no version to send for review yet. Choose another document or upload a file.

dashboard.lead: Track your review cases, pending actions and credits.
dashboard.todoEmpty: Nothing needs your action right now.

cases.lead: Every review request you've sent, from awaiting the expert to final settlement.
cases.emptyAll: You haven't sent a review request yet.

wallet.lead: Credits pay for the AI assistant and draft downloads. Expert review fees are paid separately per case.
wallet.heldHint: Held when you ask; charged once the question goes to retrieval, released if it is out of scope.
wallet.buyUnavailable: This package has no price yet, so it isn't on sale.
wallet.buySoon: Top-up via PayOS is being finished and will open in an upcoming update.

ai-question.when: Held when you send; captured once the question goes to research, even if the sources are insufficient. Follow-ups to clarify are not charged again

ai-out-of-scope.when: Detected before research; the full hold is released

ai-system-error.when: Processing failed entirely due to a platform error; 1 credit refunded

draft-export.when: DOCX or PDF export; re-downloading the same version is free

wallet.escrowNote: Shared Hub holds review fees until you accept the result or a dispute is decided.

rating.title: Rate the expert
rating.hint: Ratings are shown publicly on the expert's profile.
rating.required: Choose a star rating to submit.

errors.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS: Your wallet balance is too low. Top up, then pay again.
errors.CASE_STATUS_INVALID: The case has moved on. Reload to see its current step.
errors.CASE_DEADLINE_PASSED: The deadline for this action has passed.
errors.REVIEW_CASE_ALREADY_OPEN: This version already has an open request with that expert.
errors.CASE_SELF_REVIEW: You cannot review your own document.
errors.DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND: That document version was not found.
errors.EXPERT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The expert is not taking this service right now.
errors.PRICE_CHANGED: The expert just changed the price. The new price is shown alongside; send again if you agree.
errors.EXPERT_FULL: The expert has no free slot.
errors.SERVICE_LINK_UNAVAILABLE: The system is busy. Please try again shortly.
errors.SESSION_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: Your session could not be checked. Please try again shortly.
errors.INFO_REQUEST_LIMIT: This case has used all its information requests.
errors.DISPUTE_REASON_INVALID: That dispute reason is not valid.
errors.DISPUTE_STATEMENT_EXISTS: You have already sent your statement.
errors.DISPUTE_REFUND_INVALID: That refund percentage is not valid.
errors.RATING_CLOSED: The case is not over yet, so it cannot be rated.
errors.RATING_EXISTS: You have already rated this case.
errors.RATING_INVALID: That star rating is not valid.
errors.REVIEW_RESULT_INVALID: That review result is not valid.
errors.ATTACHMENT_TOO_LARGE: A file may be at most 50 MB.
errors.ATTACHMENT_DUPLICATE: This file is already on the case.
errors.ATTACHMENT_TYPE_INVALID: Only PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP or Word (.docx) files.
errors.ATTACHMENTS_CLOSED: Files cannot be added at this step.
errors.ATTACHMENT_LIMIT: A case holds at most 20 files.
errors.CHAT_CLOSED: Messages cannot be sent at this step.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please try again in a moment.
errors.EXTENSION_ALREADY_REQUESTED: An extension can be asked once per case.
errors.EXTENSION_NOT_PENDING: There is no extension waiting for an answer.
errors.EXTENSION_DAYS_INVALID: An extension is 1 or 2 working days.
errors.DISPUTE_AWAITING_STATEMENT: The expert can still explain; the dispute cannot be decided yet.
errors.DISPUTE_STATEMENT_CLOSED: The statement window for this dispute has ended.

live.scopeRequired: Please describe what should be reviewed.
live.earlyCancelPaid: The expert has not accepted yet, so your payment is refunded in full.

PENDING_EXPERT_RESPONSE.body: The fee is held. The expert has 1 working day to accept or decline; if they do not accept, you get a 100% refund.

DECLINED_BY_EXPERT.body: The whole fee is back in your wallet. You can send this document to another expert.

EXPERT_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT.body: The request closed and the whole fee is back in your wallet.

WITHDRAWN.body: The request closed before the expert accepted and the whole fee is back in your wallet.

EXPERT_WITHDREW.title: {{name}} stopped reviewing this case
EXPERT_WITHDREW.body: The expert stopped before delivering. The whole fee is back in your wallet.

AWAITING_PAYMENT.body: Pay within 15 minutes to send the request to {{name}}. After that it cancels and you are not charged.

CANCELLED_UNPAID.body: The 15-minute payment window ended and you were not charged.

AWAITING_USER_INFORMATION.warning: If you do not answer in time, the case ends and the fee splits by the rules fixed at booking.

TERMINATED.USER_NON_RESPONSE: You did not answer the information request in time. The fee was split by the rules fixed at booking.
TERMINATED.EXPERT_ABANDON: The expert did not deliver in time. The fee was split under the policy fixed at booking.

files.title: Attachments
files.hint: Drag files onto the button above or click to choose. PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP or Word (.docx), up to 50 MB each.
files.noSource: This document was written in the app, so there is no original file to download.

revised.title: Expert's edited version
revised.none: The expert left the draft unchanged.

expert.summaryHelpLabel: What to write in the conclusion
expert.summaryHelp: If you edit the document, turn on Track Changes in Word, attach the edited file, and summarise the main changes here so the client sees where and why you changed it.
expert.citationsHelpLabel: How to enter the legal basis
expert.citationsHelp: One reference per line, e.g. Article 9, Corporate Income Tax Law 2008. Required for a verified result; up to 20 lines, 500 characters each.
expert.withdrawHint: The client gets a full refund, you receive nothing and you get 2 violation points.
expert.acceptedFeedback: Case accepted. You can start the review.
expert.statementClosed: The statement window has ended. The administrator will decide on the evidence at hand.
expert.askLeft: {{left}} of {{max}} questions left for this case.
expert.deliveryPaused: The delivery deadline is paused until the client answers and moves by exactly the time waited.
expert.lateRule: Delivered up to {{hours}} h late: you receive {{payout}} and get 1 violation point. Not delivered within {{cancel}} h: the case is cancelled, you receive nothing and get 3 points.
expert.draftSaved: Draft saved. The client sees your revision only after delivery.
expert.decisionLate: The decision is taking longer than planned. Your share is still held, and you will be told as soon as it is decided.

extension.title: Delivery extension
extension.asked_one: The expert asks for {{count}} more working day
extension.asked_other: The expert asks for {{count}} more working days
extension.pendingClient: If you agree, the delivery deadline moves by these days and the expert is not counted late. Without an answer or if you decline, the deadline stays.
extension.pendingExpert: Waiting for the client. The deadline stays until they agree.
extension.accepted: The client agreed; the delivery deadline moved.
extension.declined: The client declined; the delivery deadline stays.
extension.requestedFeedback: Extension request sent to the client.
